svg.title: Amplitude/Phase PERMANOVA after Label-Free Alignment
svg.desc: The two groups are pooled and aligned once to a single elastic Karcher mean without using the labels. That alignment gives an amplitude distance matrix (infimum over warps of the SRSF L2 distance) and a phase distance matrix (arccos of the inner product of the square-root warp derivatives), shown as heat maps with the group blocks marked. The labels are then permuted with both matrices held fixed, and a PERMANOVA pseudo-F and permutation p-value are computed for each. In this simulated phase-only difference the phase test rejects (p = 0.005) and the amplitude test does not (p = 0.088).
svg.text: Align the pooled sample once, then permute labels on fixed amplitude and phase distances
